# DEA Land Cover (landsat)

DEA Land Cover (Landsat)

ga_ls_landcover_class_cyear_3

Version:
2.0.0
Type:
Derivative, Raster
Resolution:
30 m
Coverage:
1988 to 2024
Data updates:
Yearly frequency, Ongoing

https://knowledge.dea.ga.gov.au/data/product/dea-land-cover-landsat/?tab=description


## Data from DEA datacube 

```bash
OUTPUT_DIR=$REPODIR/../gisdata/landcover
rsync -vrP ${NCI_USERNAME}@gadi-dm.nci.org.au:/scratch/${NCI_PROJECT}/${NCI_USERNAME}/Fleurieu-swamps/ ${OUTPUT_DIR}   
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(terra)
library(exactextractr)
library(jsonlite)
library(stringr)   
library(ggplot2)
library(munsell)

```

```{r}
here::i_am("indicator/download.qmd")
r0 <- rast(here::here("gisdata/landcover/lc-cell-0.tif"))
names(r0) <- 2007:2020
fleurieu_imap <- st_read(here::here("gisdata/TEC/Swamps-Fleurieu-IM.gpkg")) |> st_transform(st_crs(r0)) 
fleurieu_aoo <- st_read(here::here("gisdata/TEC/Swamps-Fleurieu-IM_AOO.gpkg")) |> st_transform(st_crs(r0))

```


```{r}
plot(r0,1)
plot(st_geometry(fleurieu_imap),add=TRUE,col="red")
plot(st_geometry(fleurieu_aoo),add=TRUE,border="red")
```

```{r}

slc_aoo <- slice(fleurieu_aoo, 1)
slc_imap <- st_crop(fleurieu_imap,slc_aoo) |> st_union()

qry_aoo <- exact_extract(r0, slc_aoo)
qry_imap <- exact_extract(r0, slc_imap)

```

```{r}
lc_dict <- fromJSON(here::here("gisdata/landcover/lc-dict.json"))
l4_dict <- lc_dict$`level4`

labels <- str_split_fixed(sapply(l4_dict, function(x) x[5]),": ",n=2)

## this is missing some classes
l4_table <- data.frame( code = names(l4_dict), 
            R=sapply(l4_dict, function(x) as.numeric(x[1])),
            G=sapply(l4_dict, function(x) as.numeric(x[2])),
            B=sapply(l4_dict, function(x) as.numeric(x[3])),
            label=labels[,1],
            description=labels[,2])
            
 l4_tab <- read.table(here::here("gisdata/landcover/lc-l4-table.csv"), header=FALSE, sep=":", stringsAsFactors=FALSE, fill=TRUE) |> 
    setNames(c("code","class","vegetation","cover","water","surface")) |>
  mutate(across(.cols = all_of(c("class","vegetation","cover","water","surface")), .fns = trimws))

```

```{r}

code2lc <- function(data,years) {
    foreach(year=years, .combine=rbind) %do% {
        x <- data[year]
        y <- data.frame(table(x)) |>
            setNames(c("code","count")) 
        y$code <- as.integer(as.character(y$code)) 
        y$year <- as.numeric(year)
        y <- y |> left_join(l4_tab, by="code" )
        return(y)
    }
}



```

```{r}
res <- code2lc(qry_aoo[[1]], as.character(2007:2020))
res |> group_by(class,year) |> summarise(total=sum(count)) |>
ggplot( aes(x=year, y=total, fill=class)) + 
    geom_area()

res |> group_by(vegetation,year) |> summarise(total=sum(count)) |>
ggplot( aes(x=year, y=total, fill=vegetation)) + 
    geom_area()

```

```{r}
res <- code2lc(qry_imap[[1]], as.character(2007:2020))
res |> group_by(class,year) |> summarise(total=sum(count)) |>
ggplot( aes(x=year, y=total, fill=class)) + 
    geom_area()

res |> group_by(vegetation,class,year) |> summarise(total=sum(count)) |>
ggplot( aes(x=year, y=total, alpha=class,fill=vegetation)) + 
    geom_area()

res |> group_by(vegetation,cover,year) |> summarise(total=sum(count)) |>
ggplot( aes(x=year, y=total, fill=vegetation + cover)) + 
    geom_area()
```


```{r}
clrs <- c(
    mnsl(sapply(0:3, lighter, col = "5R 4/8")),
    mnsl(sapply(0:3, darker, col = "5BG 7/4"))
    )

grouped_res <- res |> 
    mutate(
        vegetation = factor(vegetation, levels=c("Herbaceous","Woody","none")),
        cover = factor(cover, levels=c("Sparse (4 to 15 %)","Open (15 to 40 %)","Open (40 to 65 %)","Closed (> 65 %)","none")),
        vegcover=interaction(vegetation,cover, drop=TRUE,lex.order = TRUE)) |> 
        group_by(vegcover,year) |> summarise(total=sum(count))

ggplot(grouped_res, aes(x=year, y=total, fill=vegcover)) + 
    geom_area() + scale_fill_manual(values=clrs)
```
